verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine and framework, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents only an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server, which is a different interface from MCP. Nothing in the pack shows an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or MCP tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
